description: align-items: stretch is the initial value of a grid item, so an item shorter than its track fills it; align-self overrides that per item, and an item with a declared height keeps it. Authored here rather than ported: this port's corpus carries no reference Expectation for grid cross-axis alignment.
visual_assertions: The first item's bordered box fills its whole 100pt track.
The second item's box is only as tall as its text and sits in the middle of its track.
The third item's box sits at the foot of its track.
The fourth item's box is about 50pt tall — its declared 40pt plus its padding — at the top of its track, because it declared a height of its own.
